_comment: Boards: 1 Portfolio Overview + 10 Squad Boards (one per Value Stream). Created via POST /rest/agile/1.0/board. Filter, columns, swim lanes and WIP limits are applied AFTER board creation via the board configuration endpoints (note: Jira Cloud's board-config API is only partially exposed; some settings — notably WIP limits — must be set in the UI). Filters reference a saved JQL filter (POST /rest/api/3/filter first, then board references that filter id).

filters.name: DP_Filter_Portfolio
filters.description: All DGTLPROD demands past Triage · for Portfolio Overview Board
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND status in (TRIAGED, REVIEWING, ANALYZING, BACKLOG, IMPLEMENTING, DONE) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Field_Operations
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Field Operations"             AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Engineering_AssetMgmt
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Engineering & Asset Mgmt"    AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Network_Ops
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Network Operations & Control" AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Corporate_Regulatory
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Corporate & Regulatory"      AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Iberdrola_Corp
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Iberdrola Corp Services"     AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.name: DP_Filter_Squad_Meter_Device
filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Meter & Device Operations"   AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC

filters.jql: project = DGTLPROD AND component = "Revenue & Collections"       AND status not in (NEW, ROUTED) ORDER BY "DP Pain Score" DESC
